en.t: I was even afraid of God.

units.source_text: 我不相信神的恩寵，只相信神的懲罰。

en.t: I did not believe in God's grace, only in God's punishment.

units.source_text: 所謂的信仰，不過是為了接受神的鞭笞，而俯首走向審判臺。

en.t: What people call faith seemed to me nothing more than bowing my head and walking toward the judgment seat in order to receive God's lash.

units.source_text: 我相信地獄，但不相信天國的存在。

en.t: I believed in hell, but I could not believe that heaven existed.
"Because Daddy did not obey his parents."

units.source_text: 「是嗎？可是大家都說爸爸是個大好人呢。」

en.t: "Really? But everyone says Daddy is a very good person."

units.source_text: 那是因為我欺騙了他們。

en.t: That was because I had deceived them.

units.source_text: 我也知道，公寓裡的人都對我抱有好感，

en.t: I also knew that everyone in the apartment building had a favorable opinion of me,

units.source_text: 可我是多麼畏懼他們啊，

en.t: but how terribly I feared them,

units.source_text: 越是畏懼就越博得他們的好感，

en.t: and the more I feared them, the more I won their goodwill,

units.source_text: 而越是博得他們的好感，就越是畏懼，

en.t: while the more I won their goodwill, the more afraid I became,
until in the end I had no choice but to distance myself from everyone.

units.source_text: 我這不幸的毛病，要向茂子說清楚實在是太困難了。

en.t: It was extremely difficult to explain this unfortunate affliction of mine clearly to Shigeko.
